name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Blue Razz
description: Berry lovers, this one’s stacked. Double-Stacked Blue Razz BITEZ layer rich, sweet blueberry with bright, tangy raspberry for that classic Blue Razz flavor with the perfect balance of sweet and tart. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A bold berry combo stacked with serious potency.
